replies.bodyText:
This code should not have been added here at all: Instantiator should stay quite generic for such functionality.
It's simply impossible to extract polymer templates into a separate module without removing this alien method.
There is a replacement for this. I've introduced a factory which can be used to get a parser instance via instantiator.
This is the proper way of doing things.
So Karibu-testing will need to correct the code. But yes, it's a breaking change.

replies.bodyText:
I don't see how.
The test can be moved but I see it's as a very bad idea.
The test checks the functionality which has not been moved: that's the reason why it's here.
Having the functionality in flow-server  but the test for it in flow-polymer-template  looks for me absolutely unacceptable.
replies.author: denis-anisimov

replies.bodyText: I wouldn't move the EventHandler class at all out from server as long as PublishedServerEventHandlerRpcHandler is automatically added to the handler list.
replies.author: caalador

replies.bodyText:
The only reason why it's added is the absence of simple way to move it to the separate module.
Well, this class has in fact only one interface method which can be called via reflection and everything else may be moved into the extracted module.
But the situation with PolymerServerEventHandlers  is different.
The point do not move the classes just because impl class can't be moved makes the whole change questionable: why to move things at all if they may stay here?
I will move logic of PublishedServerEventHandlerRpcHandler  to the module but not the PolymerServerEventHandlers.
replies.author: denis-anisimov
